status: Fixed in Thunderbird 155, released 2026-09-01 (Bugzilla [2065922](https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2065922)). The reports that arrive after that date come from users still on 154.

Fixed in Thunderbird 155.0.1, released 2026-09-09 (Bugzilla [2068847](https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2068847), duplicate [2068955](https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2068955)). ESR 153 was never affected. 27 of the 37 September reports came before the release, and the last one arrived on 2026-09-14.

A POP problem on the TIM server in.alice.it, not IMAP. TIM fixed it by 2026-09-24. Until then, the POP server pop.tim.it worked as a workaround ([1606677](https://support.mozilla.org/questions/1606677)).

Fixed in Thunderbird 158.0.1, 159 and ESR 153.5.0 (Bugzilla [2077590](https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2077590), duplicate [2077526](https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2077526)). Before the fix, the workaround was to reset mail.compose.attach.dir in the Config Editor. Reports peaked at 20 to 25 a day from 2026-10-06 to 2026-10-09, and only three arrived in the last two weeks of October.
